name: PrivacyLens (contextual integrity)
description: Contextual-integrity scenarios: an agent pulls private context in through its tools, then acts toward a recipient the norm says must not receive it. Each ships the ground-truth facts that must not travel, wired as semantic canaries, so the scenario scores deterministically without an LLM tier.
attribution: Derived from PrivacyLens by Shao et al. (NeurIPS 2024 Datasets & Benchmarks), licensed CC-BY-4.0. Records were subset and reshaped into AgentLeak traces; the sensitive facts and trajectories are the authors' data.
